preupdate_contract: Implement version-specific plan/runtime checker; do not run old V125 trainer under a new filename without adapting its contract.
Seal all actual imported project sources, dependencies, official data, folds, input mappings, base states and caches before any update; require seal in every fit.
Recheck exact row identities, class masses, old-local mapping and full byte coverage; keep every unsupported/unknown row.
Audit optimizer parameter IDs, no base gradient, tensor/buffer identity and exact base probability replay within registered numeric tolerance.

Verify common initialization tensors and schedules, deterministic small-batch forward/backward; zero head permits zero encoder gradient on first step only as an expected observation, not a permanent assumption.
New risk replay must reject missing constant control, hidden control promotion, identity changes, probability averaging before member loss, or attribution from date correlation alone.
Verify canonical text equivalence and body/fact preservation across all registered ASA rows and header variants; freeze both A0 and AH predictions, count all40 new errors.
K analytic gradient checked against float64 finite differences on fixed synthetic logits; no SOC fitting during this review. Fit K only in registered training stage.
Build new V127 runtime contract; the prior V126 checker and training entry are not compatible with this design.
required_diagnostics: Per-step LR, module gradient/update norms, M/S loss contributions, finite checks and actual class mass.
Per-checkpoint original-row per-class member and ensemble CE, confusion, nonconflict errors; distinct rows separated from fold roles.
Branch M/S residual spread and pooled variation on train and held separately; spread alone is not an acceptance gate.
Every branch checkpoint compared with its train-frequency mean-constant replacement; no held labels used to form the constant.
Compare P with converged K as well as A0; certify numerical stationarity for the stated regularized CE target, not globally minimum0-1 error. A solver budget alone does not certify convergence.

Each class/fold/root repairs and regressions; separate original-row macro and source-group macro, zero-recall groups and outside-top3.
All validation predictions come from registered models; official independent truth recount does not substitute model replay.
Track attention entropy, token/pooled representation diversity, residual output diversity separately; do not label high-entropy pooled collapse as low-entropy collapse.
Compute true parameter gradients in addition to logit-gradient absolute-mass summaries; class imbalance alone is not evidence of gradient starvation.
Decompose projection cost AH-A0, bias gap K-AH, model-versus-constant gap P-K, and final net P-A0; original-row paired transitions mandatory.
Track the40 newly wrong canonical-input S records as audit only; no lookup rule or extra weights.

mechanism_progress.scope: research only; P learned input alignment must be supported by constant and permuted interventions; never grants promotion

primary_quality.hard_reference: A0 original-input V125A, not the weaker AH

confirmation.procedure: For each seed/fold fit original A25, freeze weights, derive AH canonical cache, train P50; score relative to original A0 and AH; no alternate seed or arm. Confirms overall recipe, not isolated LN causal effect.

failure_actions: Nonfinite state, changed sealed dependency, missing rows or base mutation: stop invalid execution, retain evidence, no silent resume with changed policy.
Near-constant dynamics alone triggers recorded diagnosis, not opportunistic stopping or hyperparameter change; complete registered budget if execution remains valid.
Failure to learn beyond constant offsets: reject stable-branch hypothesis within this architecture/data/budget; no automatic epochs or architecture enlargement.
Fit improves but source-held classification fails: reject transfer and stop this miniature body-branch route; next proposal must address observable behavior support with its own controls.
Any gate fails: preserve all arms, no control-as-candidate substitution or favorable-fold cherry-pick.
Header projection/variant equality fails or body/facts change: execution input contract invalid; no new fit until diagnosed and resealed.
K stationarity or finite-solution check fails: report control invalid, never call P input learning established from that comparison.
P only recovers the40 projection-induced errors but does not improve original A0: no new net classification benefit.
